question: I was asking about the journey. Are there things from the ride or the wait that you keep thinking about afterward?
model_evidence: model and effort in native CLI rollout turn_context record
raw: Um, on Monday two people at the shelter looked up at the same time, and I felt singled out. I moved to the other end. Afterward I wondered whether they recognized me, or were just looking for the bus. I still think about it occasionally, but I don’t really know what they were looking at.
